title: In the text, a young girl named Amaka is preparing to attend her friend's all-night party. Despite her parents' disapproval of staying out late, she makes plans to attend the party and even dances with a boy named Kenny. After the party, she sneaks back into her house in the early hours of the morning, trying to avoid her parents' detection.
